mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), China
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China (MOFA PRC). Since China is an Apostille Convention member state and Taiwan is not, this path is exclusive to China-issued instruments and is never chained with consular legalization for submission within the Cross-Strait framework.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (TECO). Since Taiwan is not an Apostille Convention member state, this path is exclusive to Taiwan-issued instruments and is never chained with Hague Apostille for submission in China or other jurisdictions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the China WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China (MOFA PRC) when notarized and issued within mainland China; this standalone path must never be chained sequentially with TECO consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Shareholders Meeting of the China WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China (MOFA PRC) after notarization by a PRC notary office; this exclusive Apostille path applies only to China-sourced originals and must not be combined with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China (MOFA PRC). If the issuing bank operates from Taiwan, the document must instead follow TECO Consular Legalization; the two paths are mutually exclusive and must never be chained.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, shareholders, trust protectors, and authorized signatories of the CN_WFOE_LTD and the underlying Taiwan discretionary asset protection trust must undergo mandatory screening against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the PRC Ministry of Public Security (MPS) sanctions list, and the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) AML/CFT blacklist. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) must be identified, with enhanced due diligence applied to current or former senior foreign officials, their families, and close associates. Automated name screening must run pre-onboarding, continuously across all transaction payment rails (Fiduciary_Trust_Account and Swift_Wire), and be re-run within 24 hours of any sanctions list update. Any positive hit or PEP identification triggers a mandatory Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) and escalation to the AML/CFT Compliance Committee.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS) and the SAMR Online Name Clearance and Reservation Platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Chinese-language corporate name must strictly follow the four-tier naming doctrine: (1) Administrative Region; (2) Trade Name (Zihao); (3) Industry Activity; and (4) Organizational Form. Only simplified Chinese characters are permitted for the official SAMR registration. The English legal name must be a direct putonghua Pinyin transliteration of the Chinese Zihao to ensure phonetic parity, and this English name is used solely for Customs, foreign exchange, and cross-border banking transactional filings.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon issuance of a formal SAMR name rejection notice, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration application (Xingzheng Fuyi) with the immediately higher-level SAMR within 60 calendar days. If the reconsideration results in an adverse determination, the applicant has a further 15 calendar days to file an administrative lawsuit (Xingzheng Susong) with the competent People's Intermediate Court. The appeal must include the original rejection notice, a corrected four-tier name structure proposal, and a comparative legal brief demonstrating non-identical, non-confusing distinctiveness against existing approved trade names.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is categorically prohibited. The local SAMR, the State Taxation Administration, and the local Financial Regulatory Bureau (FRB) require the WFOE to maintain a physical, self-owned or long-term-leased office staffed with an employed statutory representative, financial officer, and trust compliance officer. For the high-risk ISIC 6430 fiduciary sector, the regulators demand evidence of substantive administrative operations, including physical servers or secure filing cabinets for trust deeds, board meeting rooms, and original lease agreements with rental payment proof. A virtual office will result in administrative cancellation, company blacklisting, bank account closure, and a recharacterization as a sham trust realm under the General Anti-Avoidance Rules (GAAR).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified Risk: High (85% probability within the first 12 months of incorporation). Municipal SAMR and FRB conduct unannounced on-site inspections triggered by high-risk NAICS 525920 classification. Checklist: (1) Verification of the exact physical location, lease registration, and on-site staff presence; (2) Forensic audit of board minutes, trust client files, and beneficial ownership register; (3) Inspection of accounting ledgers, bank statements, and SWIFT wire records; (4) Validation of information technology infrastructure and data-residency compliance; (5) Interviews of the statutory representative and compliance officers; (6) Cross-match of payroll, social insurance, and individual income tax filings.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of Taiwan (R.O.C.), Articles 1-7 on corporate existence, Articles 128-131 on shareholders and promoters, Articles 156-161 on capital and shares, Articles 192-216 on directors and supervisors, Article 208 on chairperson, Article 387 on registration and documents, and Article 419 on application filings; supplemented by the Trust Enterprise Act Articles 1-4 and 12-21, and the Money Laundering Control Act Articles 1-8 for fiduciary trust licensing.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (R.O.C.) - Company Registration Office
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of a Limited Liability Company (Company Registration Application Form) under Article 387 of the Company Act
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-in capital exists under the Taiwan Company Act. However, before the Financial Supervisory Commission will issue a fiduciary trust operating licence, the company must demonstrate adequate paid-in capital and a capital adequacy plan, and the subscribed capital must be placed in a blocked escrow account at a Taiwan licensed bank, released only after the company registration certificate and business registration are obtained. The escrow agreement must prohibit withdrawals without the joint signature of the designated certified public accountant and a director.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF CN_WFOE_LTD

THIS RESOLUTION, made on the ____ day of __________, 20____, records the unanimous actions of the first Board of Directors (the Board) of CN_WFOE_LTD, a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise limited liability company organised under the Company Act of Taiwan (R.O.C.) (the Company). The Company is established to carry on fiduciary administration of irrevocable offshore spendthrift trusts under ISIC 6430 and NAICS 525920, a regulated trust enterprise business requiring, prior to any client acceptance, a special permit from the Financial Supervisory Commission and registration under the Money Laundering Control Act.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS:

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The Board approves the initial authorised share capital set out in the Articles of Incorporation and authorises the sole shareholder to subscribe for all issued shares, to execute share subscription certificates, to deposit the full subscription consideration into a blocked escrow account at a licensed bank in Taiwan, and to obtain a certified capital verification report from a Taiwan certified public accountant for filing with the competent registry.

2. BANKING AUTHORISATION. The Board authorises the opening of the Company's corporate operating account, payroll account, and segregated fiduciary trust accounts with a bank to be selected by the Chairperson. All payments and transfers are to be made under the dual-signature rule, requiring the signatures of the Chairperson and the AML Compliance Officer, or of any two directors lawfully appointed, and no single officer may execute banking instructions alone.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. The registered office of the Company is adopted as the address recorded in the Articles of Incorporation, Taiwan (R.O.C.). The Chairperson is authorised to execute the lease, engage legal counsel, file the address with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, and display the incorporation certificate and business licence at the registered office.

4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. The Board appoints [Name] as Chairperson and statutory Director, [Name] as General Manager, [Name] as Corporate Secretary, and [Name] as AML Compliance Officer. Each officer shall exercise the powers and bear the duties imposed by the Company Act, the Trust Enterprise Act, the Money Laundering Control Act, and the internal control policy of the Company, and each officer shall serve until resignation, death, or removal by ordinary resolution of the shareholders.

5. CONDITION PRECEDENT. Each authorisation herein is conditional upon the grant of the fiduciary trust operating licence and the completion of tax and labour registrations. The Board directs management to implement the four-eyes principle, customer due diligence procedures, risk-assessment policies, and reporting protocols before the first client onboarding.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that this Resolution shall be binding on all directors and officers, filed in the corporate minute book, and produced to the Financial Supervisory Commission and the Ministry of Economic Affairs as evidence of corporate governance authorisation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Capital Source Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (R.O.C.)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed Foreign Investment Application through the MOEA Online Investment Application Portal, together with notarised constitutive documents of the ultimate foreign investor, audited financial statements for the immediate past fiscal year, a board resolution of the investor authorising the Taiwan subsidiary capital commitment, and a power of attorney executed in favour of the local formation agent. The application must state ISIC 6430 as the primary business scope, disclose the fiduciary trust administration model, and identify the beneficial owner and source of funds. All Chinese translations must be certified, and foreign-issued documents must be apostilled or authenticated under applicable conventions. The Commission will vet the investment for national security, foreign exchange control, money-laundering, and special-licence concerns. If a deficiency letter is issued, the applicant must respond in writing within 30 calendar days; failure to cure may result in a formal denial.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Application Form
Investor board resolution authorising the Taiwan WFOE
Power of attorney to local formation agent
Business plan for trust administration and asset protection services
Certified copies of the investor's certificate of incorporation or passport
Audited financial statements for the latest fiscal year
Source-of-funds declaration and bank reference letter
Certified Chinese translation of all foreign documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the MOEA deficiency letter within 30 calendar days. If the application is denied, file a formal administrative appeal with the Executive Yuan within 30 days from service of the denial, or resubmit with amended scope and capital structure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Corporate Charter Execution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (R.O.C.) via the One-Stop Company Registration System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the MOEA One-Stop Company Registration System to pre-book the English company name CN_WFOE_LTD and one alternate name. The reservation is valid for six months and may be renewed once before incorporation. The Articles of Incorporation must be drafted in Chinese and state the company name, registered office, authorised share capital, share classes, number of directors and supervisors, business scope limited to trust enterprise operations and asset protection trust administration, and the method of appointment and removal of officers. The draft articles must be signed by the sole foreign shareholder and by every first director and supervisor. Each signature must be notarised by a Taiwan notary, and documents originating outside Taiwan must be legalised by a Taiwan Overseas Representative Office or through notarisation by a recognised notary public, before filing.
required_dossiers: Name reservation receipt from the MOEA one-stop portal
Execution draft of the Chinese Articles of Incorporation
Foreign investment approval certificate from the Investment Commission
Notarised identity documents of all proposed directors and supervisors
Consent letters of proposed directors, supervisor, and officers
Notarised power of attorney for the local representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as identical or confusingly similar, file for an alternate name immediately. If the articles are queried, amend and notarise the revised articles within 10 days and resubmit without losing the reservation priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing and Capital Verification with MOEA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan (R.O.C.)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the formal Application for Registration of a Limited Liability Company together with the Articles of Incorporation, the Foreign Investment Approval Certificate, the bank escrow certificate evidencing deposit of the paid-in capital, the certified public accountant capital verification report, consent of directors, and the registered office lease with landlord consent. The application must include a declaration that the company will not commence regulated business until the trust enterprise licence is granted. The Department reviews compliance, issues the incorporation certificate, and registers the statutory officers. The certificate is conclusive evidence of corporate existence. After issuance, the company must display the certificate at the registered office and keep a corporate seal. If the documents contain discrepancies, the Department will issue a correction notice requiring amendment within 14 days.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Application (Form 1)
Notarised Articles of Incorporation
Foreign Investment Approval Certificate
Bank escrow certificate of subscribed capital
CPA capital verification report
Registered office lease and landlord consent
Consent and identity documents of directors and supervisor
Certified corporate seal specimen
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct the discrepancies and resubmit within 14 days after the MOEA correction notice. If formally rejected, file an administrative reconsideration application to MOEA within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Uniform Invoice, and Labour Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (R.O.C.)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to the National Taxation Bureau having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office for profit-seeking enterprise tax registration and uniform invoice registration, using the newly issued incorporation certificate. The tax application must list ISIC 6430 and the trust enterprise business as the principal activities and identify all withholding obligations for trust income and trustee fees. The Bureau will assign a taxpayer identification number and, if taxable turnover is anticipated, a Uniform Invoice serial block. The company must simultaneously register as an employer with the local Bureau of Labor Insurance and pay labour and health insurance premiums for staff. The registered office must be the same address as the tax registration; a change requires amendment of both records.
required_dossiers: Company incorporation certificate
Profit-seeking enterprise tax registration application
Uniform invoice registration application
Registered office lease and address proof
Director and officer identification
Bank account certificate
Employer registration forms for labour insurance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is queried due to address mismatch, file a corrected lease and a declaration from the landlord. If the query relates to business scope, provide the FSC pre-licence correspondence showing trust enterprise application status.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trust Enterprise Special Licence and AML Regime Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the incorporation certificate and tax identification number, submit the trust enterprise licence application to the FSC under the Trust Enterprise Act and the Enforcement Rules of the Money Laundering Control Act. The application must describe the proposed irrevocable offshore spendthrift trust products, the source of funds of the foreign shareholder, the segregation methodology for client assets, the identity of the responsible person and AML compliance officer, the internal controls for customer due diligence, record retention, suspicious transaction reporting, and threshold reporting, and the company's capital adequacy position. The FSC will conduct a documentation review and may undertake an onsite inspection of the registered office. The licence will be issued with operating conditions limiting the types of trust activities and requiring periodic reporting. The company must not accept clients prior to licence issuance.
required_dossiers: FSC trust enterprise licence application form
Detailed business plan for asset protection trust administration
AML/CFT internal control policy
Customer due diligence and record-keeping procedures
Capital adequacy and funding statement
Compliance officer appointment letter
Incorporation certificate and tax registration certificate
Organisational chart and shareholder UBO declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FSC issues a deficiency letter, submit a corrective plan within 60 days. If the application is denied, the company may request a hearing and resubmit with amended controls; the denial is appealable under the Administrative Procedure Act within 30 days of receipt.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable for industrial plant licensing; the operative authority is the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), Taiwan (R.O.C.), for fiduciary trust licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Trust Enterprise Operating Permit issued under the Trust Enterprise Act, together with the profit-seeking enterprise tax registration and uniform invoice registration.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Full EIA not required. The registered use is a general office for fiduciary trust administration, not an ISIC 1xxx, 2xxx, 3xxx, 4xxx or 52xx manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing activity. The activity is outside the development classes listed in the Environmental Impact Assessment Act.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable as no process wastewater, volatile organic compounds, or hazardous waste streams are generated. General office waste must be collected by licensed municipal carriers. If an emergency diesel generator is installed, its stationary source emissions must comply with Taiwan Air Pollution Control Act thresholds for emergency generators, and the office's cooling or HVAC system must use refrigerants permitted under the Ozone Layer Protection Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The office must obtain a fire safety equipment inspection certificate and fire protection compliance endorsement from the local Fire Bureau under the Civil Defense regulations. The premises must have functional smoke detectors, fire extinguishers, illuminated exit signs, and allowed occupancy load. Under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, the company must provide a workplace safety plan, first-aid supplies, emergency evacuation training, and compulsory labour and health insurance for employees. A structural load certificate is not required because no industrial machinery or storage racking is installed.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance (MOF), Tax Administration, Taiwan; administered in jurisdiction by the National Taxation Bureau regional offices. Online portals: MOF Tax Entry Portal at etax.nat.gov.tw and the E-Invoice Cloud Service Platform at einvoice.nat.gov.tw.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. Obtain the required statutory trust administration license from the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) under the Trust Enterprise Act before tax registration, because the declared business scope is fiduciary administration of an offshore spendthrift trust. 2. For a foreign-owned Taiwan limited company, obtain investment approval from the Investment Commission, MOEA, under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, including any applicable mainland-China investor review if the ultimate owner is a mainland-China entity, and complete company registration with the Department of Commerce, MOEA; the 8-digit Unified Business Number (UBN) is issued at company registration. 3. If instead the foreign non-resident entity supplies cross-border electronic services without a fixed place of business in Taiwan, appoint a registered tax agent, file the online application for tax registration for cross-border electronic services with the National Taxation Bureau via the MOF tax portal, and obtain a non-resident UBN. 4. Complete business tax registration under the Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax Act with the competent National Taxation Bureau before starting taxable sales in Taiwan. 5. Register for Uniform Invoice / Electronic Uniform Invoice (EUI) capability or arrange issuance through a licensed intermediary. The UBN functions as the statutory TIN for income tax, VAT/business tax, customs, and all tax filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (Taiwan does not have a check-the-box entity election or hybrid mismatch election regime; tax classification follows the Company Act, Income Tax Act, and Trust Enterprise Act and is not elective).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax (VAT-type business tax under the Business Tax Act)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration is triggered when a fixed-place business has average monthly taxable sales exceeding NT$80,000 for goods or NT$40,000 for services; non-resident suppliers of electronic services have a simplified VAT registration threshold when annual taxable sales exceed NT$480,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No per-invoice pre-clearance or anti-fraud digital stamp is imposed. Taiwan requires Uniform Invoice issuance for taxable sales; Electronic Uniform Invoices (EUI) must be transmitted through the approved Turnkey Gateway/API to the MOF E-Invoice Cloud Service Platform for storage, lottery processing, and VAT reconciliation. EUI data is reconciled in the periodic VAT return (usually monthly or quarterly), and compliance is enforced through encrypted QR code validation, controlled invoice number ranges, and cross-validation between EUI records and filed VAT returns.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act, 0% VAT applies when: (a) goods are physically exported from Taiwan customs territory and evidenced by a valid customs export declaration; or (b) services are supplied to a foreign enterprise or individual and used outside Taiwan, including qualified trust administration services rendered by a licensed entity to a non-resident discretionary trust, provided the economic benefit is consumed outside Taiwan and the service fee is paid from abroad in foreign currency and remitted into Taiwan. The zero-rating claim is valid only if contemporaneous export, transport, contract, invoicing, and foreign-exchange records are retained and the zero-rated sales are disclosed in the VAT return within the statutory filing period.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Entry / Customs Export Declaration bearing the Taiwan Customs Administration clearance number
Ocean Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export movement
Export commercial invoice and sales contract, plus any third-party export instruction document if shipment is made by a third party
Bank-issued Export Foreign Exchange Settlement Certificate or Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Taiwan tax authorities require full customs, transport, contractual, invoice, and foreign-exchange evidence to support every export zero-rating claim. If the claim is unverified or fraudulent, the zero rating is reversed, VAT is assessed at 5% with overdue interest computed from the original tax due date, and the taxpayer may face penalty exposure under the Business Tax Act and Tax Collection Act, including statutory fines of 5 to 15 times the evaded tax, business suspension, and criminal liability where forged or fraudulent documentation is used.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC), acting through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is convertible for current account items under a managed floating exchange rate regime, while the capital account remains subject to SAFE registration and approval gates. The WFOE's receipt of trust capital contributed by a Taiwan-based discretionary trust is an inbound direct investment, requiring an FDI basic registration before any remittance, a designated foreign currency capital account, and capital verification by a Chinese CPA. Once registered, the proceeds may be converted to RMB under the willing conversion settlement regime, but the bank will verify underlying business authenticity and may request payment counterparty documentation before releasing each RMB payment from the pending settlement account. Current account earnings, including trust administration fees and treasury management fees, are freely convertible for bona fide transactions, subject to authenticity review and tax withholding. Profit remittance to the Taiwan trustee is not a free dividend channel: the WFOE must complete the annual statutory audit, file and settle corporate income tax, obtain a board resolution on profit distribution, and submit a SAFE profit remittance form through the domestic bank; tax certificates and non-resident withholding clearances are usually required. In practice, banks also screen for round-tripping and require documentary proof that the trust corpus and beneficiaries are not sourced from mainland China residents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods exports, SAFE and the customs authority operate an electronic matching regime rather than a fixed percentage surrender. The WFOE must repatriate 100% of export-related foreign exchange receipts into China and must not leave funds offshore. The standard monitoring benchmark is that export proceeds must be collected within 90 days from the date of customs declaration; if the commercial terms exceed 90 days, a trade credit report must be lodged with SAFE through the bank. Upon receipt, funds may be credited to a foreign exchange current account or settled to RMB at the PBOC-designated bank at the prevailing spot rate. There is no mandatory conversion ratio in the current account, but 100% repatriation and matching to the export customs record are mandatory; any historical surrender obligation has been superseded by the current trade foreign-exchange verification and willing settlement system for Normal-class enterprises.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Not viable as the WFOE's licensed banking counterparty. Under PBOC and NFRA rules, offshore digital EMI or e-money institutions do not hold a Chinese bank license and cannot maintain a RMB basic settlement account, receive FDI capital remittances, perform SAFE registration, or issue capital verification statements. Using a foreign EMI as an intermediary for capital injection is legally barred and would create serious AML and round-tripping red flags. At most, an offshore EMI may be used by the Taiwan trust to initiate a SWIFT payment to the WFOE's domestic bank, but the onshore account relationship, FX conversion, and clearing must sit with a licensed China commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is mandatory for the WFOE's legal representative when opening the RMB basic deposit account and any foreign exchange account. PBOC real-name account verification rules and commercial bank AML procedures require the legal representative, beneficial owner or controller, and senior compliance officer to attend a face-to-face interview at the branch. Remote consular proxy opening is not generally accepted for the statutory legal representative; the branch may allow the designated manager to act only after the legal representative has completed in-person verification. Where the legal representative is a Taiwanese national, the physical visit should be made with a valid passport and Taiwan Compatriot Permit or Mainland Travel Permit, plus original corporate documents. For non-statutory directors, a notarized power of attorney, board resolution, and a notarized copy of the director's passport may be accepted after legal representative verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discretionary trust structure with no fixed beneficiaries creates UBO opacity and possible hidden control by settlor or protector.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified trust instrument, current letter of wishes, protector appointment and powers, trustee board resolutions identifying discretionary beneficiaries, trust register of substantial controllers, PRC beneficial owner information filing for the WFOE, notarized English translations, and a legal opinion confirming Taiwan trust law and PRC enterprise law attribution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of wealth and source of funds for the inbound capital contribution from the offshore trust cannot be substantiated.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three years of audited financial statements for the trust and settlor, original bank statements of the funding account, a source-of-wealth statement with supporting investment, inheritance, or gift documents, an independent forensic accountant's report on source of funds, CRS and FATCA tax residence declarations, and bank-to-bank confirmation if requested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: ISIC 6430 fiduciary trust administration without a PRC trust license or with business-scope mismatch creates exposure to unlicensed financial services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the trust or financial business license if the WFOE acts as a trust company, SAMR business license with exact scope, AML/CFT internal procedures and risk assessment, trust engagement letters, evidence of segregated client money accounts, auditor's opinion on regulatory compliance, and a no-deposit-taking confirmation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border round-tripping or illegal capital inflow through a Taiwan trust that may, in substance, be controlled by mainland residents or that diverts China-source assets.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI basic registration and capital injection schedule, complete ownership and investment chain from the Taiwan trustee to the WFOE, declarations that neither settlor nor beneficiaries are mainland residents or entities, transfer-pricing and intercompany agreements, tax returns evidencing no mainland asset divestment, and a compliance certificate from the Taiwan trustee confirming trust assets originate outside the PRC.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound funds from the Taiwan trust must be wired via SWIFT MT103 from the trustee's bank account to the WFOE's SAFE-designated FDI capital account at a mainland licensed bank. Prior to remittance, the WFOE and the Taiwan trust must complete the FDI basic registration at the local SAFE or delegated bank; the foreign exchange purpose code for the remittance must identify foreign direct investment capital contribution rather than a current account code. The bank will verify that the remitter name matches the registered foreign shareholder, the amount is within the registered investment amount, and the source bank is not on a FATF action list. After receipt, the CPA issues a capital verification report; the funds may be placed in a pending RMB settlement account under willing conversion and released only for verified business expenditures such as salaries, rent, raw materials, and services. For RMB injections, use the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) with the same SAFE registration reference and the proper payment purpose code or SAFE case reference in the payment message.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational disbursements should use standard bank clearing rails. Domestic RMB payments flow through CNAPS; cross-border RMB payments flow through CIPS. Foreign-currency wires use SWIFT MT103 or MT202 COVER. For goods trade with overseas suppliers, use commercial letters of credit (SWIFT MT700) and documentary collections (D/P or D/A) through the domestic issuing bank. For service fees and trust administration expenses, use wire transfers with current account purpose codes, prorated tax invoices, and supporting contracts. Outbound profit distribution to the Taiwan trust must be supported by audited financial statements, a board resolution on dividend distribution, proof that corporate income tax and the associated withholding tax have been settled, and a SAFE profit remittance application. Dividends cannot be paid from paid-up capital and must not be funded with cross-border financing proceeds.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore RMB/USD deliverable forwards on a real-exposure basis via a SAFE-designated bank; naked speculative forwards are prohibited.
Onshore RMB FX swaps (RMB/USD and other interbank tradable currencies) for short-term liquidity conversion, supported by cash-flow forecasts and underlying trade or investment receipts.
Onshore RMB FX options, including vanilla puts/calls and zero-cost collars, with premium settlement and underlying position verification by the bank.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps are permissible only for long-term loan or lease exposures and must be documented under a master agreement with a licensed onshore bank; speculative derivative use is prohibited.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permitted for the onshore WFOE; only the Taiwan trustee could execute NDFs offshore in its own name, and such hedging must not be booked in the Chinese entity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting approval of financial statements, business report, and signed minutes deposited with the company registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial and Company Registration (Taipei office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, no later than 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Responsible directors and corporate secretaries are liable to administrative fines of NT$10,000 to NT$50,000 per officer under the Taiwan Company Act; if the Ministry of Economic Affairs issues a rectification order and the company fails to cure within 30 days, the company is logged as non-compliant and may be placed in inactive status, followed by administrative strike-off or ex officio dissolution after 90 days of continued default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign and Mainland Investment Annual Operations Survey and Ownership Confirmation Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC), mainland investment review division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for the preceding calendar year; the electronic reporting window ordinarily opens on 1 May and closes on 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file constitutes a breach of the investment approval conditions; MOEAIC serves a rectification demand and may impose administrative fines, suspend capital-change filings, block the transfer of shares, revoke the mainland investment permit, and ultimately direct the company registrar to strike off the WFOE if not cured within the demand period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Trust Enterprise Report, Trust Property Register, and Audited Financial Statements for the licensed fiduciary entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), Banking Bureau, Taipei
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year entities, final filing by 30 April; quarterly trust property reports are due one month after each quarter-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The FSC may impose administrative fines of NT$200,000 to NT$50,000,000, restrict trust business operations, order removal of responsible persons, suspend the special trust license, and for material or repeated failure revoke the license; revocation automatically triggers a statutory liquidation notice and corporate strike-off within 90 days.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Compliance Certification, Risk Assessment, and Suspicious Transaction Activity Report for the discretionary asset protection trust portfolio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Intelligence Unit, Investigation Bureau, Ministry of Justice; Financial Supervisory Commission for AML supervision of the trust license
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual certification due by 31 July; suspicious transaction reports due no later than 10 business days after identification; continuous monitoring and annual board-level AML sign-off required throughout the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Violations of the Money Laundering Control Act attract administrative fines up to NT$5,000,000 per finding and a cure order; willful non-filing is a criminal offense punishable by imprisonment of up to five years; sustained AML failure is a statutory disqualification event requiring revocation of the trust license and strike-off of the fiduciary registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return and Undistributed Retained Earnings Surtax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office in Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year company, from 1 May to 31 May of the following year; if e-filed with a certified CPA, the deadline is extended by ten days to 10 June; for an MOEA-approved non-calendar fiscal year, the return is due within five months after year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-filing surcharge of 10% of the unpaid tax is imposed, plus monthly compound interest at the one-year postal fixed deposit rate; after a written tax demand remains unpaid, the tax authority may attach assets, impose exit bans on responsible officers, and block deregistration of the WFOE until the entire tax liability, surcharge, and interest are satisfied.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Register Audit Certificate and Board Confirmation Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Board of directors, licensed corporate secretary/statutory auditor, with a copy retained at the registered office and available to MOEA and FSC upon inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year entities, final certification by 28 February of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: An incomplete or false register audit is a breach of the corporate secretary's statutory duty and may expose responsible officers to civil liability and criminal penalties for false statutory declarations, including imprisonment up to three years; persistent uncorrected defects are treated by MOEA as grounds for administrative strike-off after a final rectification notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership and Share Transfer Notification, including 30-day post-event reporting of trust, pledge, or member changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC) and the Ministry of Economic Affairs company registry; simultaneous confirmation to the FSC for trust-ledger changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation embedded in the 30 June operations report; any shareholding transfer, issuance, pledge, or change of beneficial ownership must be notified within 30 calendar days after the event and, for mainland capital, must obtain MOEAIC approval before the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unapproved mainland transfers are void against the Taiwan authority and may be ordered unwound; late or false 30-day notifications are penalized with fines, suspension of the offending shares, and revocation of approval; continuous failure becomes an administrative forfeiture trigger that ends in deregistration of the WFOE.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent CPA audit is compulsory if any one of the following exists: paid-in capital or net equity reaches NT$30,000,000 or more; total balance-sheet assets exceed NT$100,000,000; annual operating revenue exceeds NT$50,000,000; or the average number of employees exceeds 100 during the fiscal year. Audit is also mandatory regardless of size for any entity holding a Trust Enterprise license, any public company, bank, insurance company, securities firm, financial holding company, or other institution supervised by the FSC, and for any mainland-funded or foreign-invested enterprise directed by MOEAIC or the FSC to file audited financial statements. The trust-licensed WFOE in this payload is therefore compulsorily audited because fiduciary trust administration is a high-risk special license activity even if the capital, assets, revenue, or headcount tests are not met.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial statements must be prepared in New Taiwan Dollars under the Business Entity Accounting Act and submitted in accordance with Taiwan-IFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission; for cross-border consolidation, the Chinese parent applies IFRS as issued by the IASB or China GAAP for PRC statutory reporting, while the Taiwan trust-licensed entity applies full Taiwan-IFRS presentation because it is a financial fiduciary institution; smaller non-public entities below the audit threshold may apply the Taiwan SME IFRS abbreviated framework, but the trust license removes the SME exemption.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The WFOE must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Information Register identifying every natural person that directly or indirectly holds more than 25% of capital, voting rights, or trust interests. Annual UBO confirmation is due with the MOEAIC operations report on or before 30 June. Any share transfer, issuance, pledge, or other change in the beneficial ownership of the discretionary asset protection trust must be reported to the Investment Commission within 30 days of the event; a transfer involving mainland capital is ineffective against the Taiwan authorities unless prior MOEAIC approval has been obtained, and an unapproved transfer is subject to administrative unwinding and monetary penalties.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholders and board meetings
Trust Property Ledger and Trust Register

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$1,800 - US$3,500 per year for a licensed corporate secretarial agent and registered office in the Taipei financial district; US$900 - US$1,800 per year in secondary Taiwan cities
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$8,000 - US$25,000 per year for a certified CPA audit under Taiwan-IFRS, including trust asset verification, AML/CFT compliance review, and consolidated-schedule support for the China parent

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: PRC enterprise income tax is calculated at 25%; preferential 15% rate is available to qualified High and New Technology Enterprises; small low-profit enterprises enjoy reduced effective rates on taxable income up to RMB 3 million under the small-scale preferential policy; R&D expenses are super-deductible at 100%; special economic zones and free trade areas may offer local incentives but no blanket free-zone tax exemption for trust or fiduciary services is assumed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: People's Republic of China Corporate Income Tax Annual Tax Return for Resident Enterprises, Class A (main form plus Schedule A105000 tax adjustment, Schedule A107011 tax-exempt income, and Schedule A108000 foreign tax credit), filed through the State Taxation Administration e-Filing portal (Electronic Tax Bureau).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing with quarterly provisional instalment returns; quarterly prepayment returns are due within 15 days after each quarter-end and the annual final settlement return is due annually.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual enterprise income tax return must be filed and the final balance of tax paid on or before May 31 of the year following the relevant fiscal year, as required by Article 54 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification and fiscal year information: legal name, unified social credit code, tax registration status, registered address, industry code, accounting standard, and the tax period covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must clearly identify itself as a resident enterprise incorporated under PRC law. The Taiwan discretionary trust, as ultimate owner, must be disclosed in the beneficial ownership and shareholder schedules; if any trust protector or beneficiary is a PRC tax resident, the return should reflect the resulting PRC worldwide tax exposure and CFC or transparency risk.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating revenue: all gross income from the fiduciary administration of irrevocable offshore spendthrift trusts, including trustee fees, administration commissions, asset custody fees, advisory fees, and other fee income related to ISIC 6430 activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report revenue on an accrual basis under PRC Accounting Standards. Cross-border service revenue must be sourced to the PRC where the WFOE performs the core trust administration functions; do not allocate revenue to the Taiwan trust unless a valid service arrangement exists. Under-daiming offshore fee income is a common trigger for tax evasion investigation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating cost: direct costs attributable to generating the fiduciary service revenue, including salaries, premises, software, data processing, compliance, legal, sub-custodian and professional fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to the Taiwan trust, its beneficiaries, or related trustees must satisfy the arm's length standard under Article 41 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law. Any intercompany management fee paid to the trust must be supported by contracts, evidence of actual services, records, invoices, and withholding tax clearance; a non-substantive fee will be disallowed and recharacterized as a distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxes and surcharges, selling expenses, administrative expenses, and financial expenses: the complete period expense schedule of the WFOE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not deduct PRC income tax, late payment fees, or criminal fines. Interest paid to the Taiwan trust or foreign lenders must be at arm's length and is deductible only if the 10% withholding tax is paid and the lending is ancillary to the WFOE's substantive business. Excessively leveraged trust structures will be subject to thin-capitalization and general anti-avoidance adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit and tax reconciliation: starting from profit before taxation and then adjusting via Schedule A105000 for tax law differences, tax-exempt income, non-deductible expenditures, incentives, and loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tax losses may be carried forward for only 5 years and only against the same legal entity's taxable income; the WFOE cannot surrender losses to the Taiwan trust or to the beneficiaries. Non-resident related-party payments that are disallowed must be added back. Tax-exempt dividend income must be substantiated with the resident taxpayer identification and withholding evidence where applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income, applicable tax rate, and tentative income tax liability: calculation of the gross amount at 25%, applying any preferential 15% rate where a high-tech certificate is held.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the Taiwan trust is ultimately controlled by PRC residents and lacks economic substance, tax authorities may apply substance-over-form and general anti-abuse rules to re-attribute the WFOE's income to the trust, resulting in reassessment at effective rates plus late interest and penalties. The WFOE must not claim treaty relief directly on its own income unless a permanent establishment is at issue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Separate declaration and payment of withholding tax on profits distributed or deemed distributed to the non-resident enterprise investor, and on outbound interest, royalties, and service fees paid to the Taiwan trust.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE acts as withholding agent. The domestic withholding rate on dividends, interest, and royalties paid to a non-resident enterprise is 10%. A reduced rate under an applicable tax treaty or Cross-Strait arrangement may be claimed only after the non-resident beneficial owner provides a Tax Residency Certificate, a beneficial ownership declaration, and documentary evidence of substantive ownership; the 10% statutory rate is otherwise mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax due or refund after tax credits: computation of the net balance payable or refundable with the annual return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits on income sourced outside mainland China must be reported on the applicable schedules and cannot exceed the PRC tax liability on that foreign income. Any tax overpayment from the quarterly provisional returns will be refunded only after the annual settlement is processed; any underpayment triggers interest from the original due date.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return attracts a fixed penalty of RMB 200 to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 in serious cases; late payment creates a daily late interest surcharge of 0.05% on the unpaid tax from the statutory due date. Understatement or concealment of taxable income constitutes tax evasion under Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, exposing the company to a penalty of 50% to five times the underpaid tax and, if criminal, to confiscation and imprisonment under Article 201 of the Criminal Law. Non-payment after assessment can lead to bank account freezes, attachment of assets, exit bans, and blacklisting by the tax authority.
